title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job:**

Senior Human Resources Manager

**Job Location: Coimbatore**

**Experience Range: 5-8+ yrs.**

**About the company**
:

Waggle is looking for a strategic and execution-focused HR Head with strong expertise in Talent

Acquisition, Performance Management Systems (PMS), and Learning & Development (L&D). The

role will play a critical part in building a high-performing workforce, strengthening leadership

pipelines, and driving continuous employee development aligned with business goals.

Explore Waggle: www.mywaggle.com / https://corp.mywaggle.com/visit www.nimblewireless.com

**Our Employees are at the core of everything we do:**

Waggle is a fast-growing pet-tech startup on a mission to make pet safety smarter and stress-free. We

build innovative, real-time monitoring solutions that help pet parents stay connected to their pets

anytime, anywhere—especially on the move. At Waggle, we combine cutting-edge technology with a

deep love for pets, creating products that deliver peace of mind while

fostering a culture of ownership, speed, and continuous growth.

**Our Core Values:**

 • Embrace and Drive Change

• Be Adventurous, Creative, and Open-Minded

• Making Growth and Learning a habit

• Build a Positive Team and Family Spirit

 • Do More with Less

• Be Passionate and Persistent

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

Key Responsibilities – 12 Impact Areas

1. **Talent Acquisition Champion:**
   Own and drive end-to-end recruitment strategies, from workforce planning and sourcing to onboarding, with a strong focus on technology and leadership hiring.
2. **Strategic Talent Hunter:**
   Identify, attract, and engage top talent through innovative sourcing, proactive headhunting, networking, and recruitment partnerships.
3. **Recruitment Excellence:**
   Monitor key hiring metrics, including time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, offer acceptance rates, and quality of hire, to continuously improve recruitment efficiency.
4. **Performance Management Driver:**
   Lead performance management cycles, including goal setting, KRAs, KPIs, appraisals, continuous feedback, and performance improvement initiatives.
5. **Employee Engagement Catalyst:**
   Design meaningful engagement, recognition, and retention initiatives that strengthen employee experience and workplace culture.
6. **Learning & Development Enabler:**
   Identify skill gaps, implement learning programs, and support technical, behavioral, and leadership development initiatives.
7. **Strategic HR Business Partner:**
   Collaborate with business leaders to align talent strategies, workforce planning, and people initiatives with organizational goals.
8. **Employee Lifecycle Expert:**
   Manage the complete employee journey, ensuring seamless onboarding, employee relations, grievance resolution, career development, and structured exits.
9. **HR Operations & Compliance Guardian:**
   Oversee HR operations, payroll coordination, employee documentation, statutory compliance, labor laws, and audit readiness.
10. **People Analytics Enthusiast:**
    Leverage HR dashboards, workforce insights, attrition trends, and performance analytics to support data-driven business decisions.
11. **HR Process & Automation Innovator:**
    Streamline HR workflows, enhance HRMS utilization, introduce automation, and drive continuous process improvements.
12. **Culture & Leadership Builder:**
    Mentor HR team members, champion organizational values, build succession pipelines, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and high performance.

What Makes You the Right Fit?

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* **8–10 years of progressive HR experience**
  , with proven expertise in Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and HR Business Partnering.
* Strong track record in technical recruitment, leadership hiring, and strategic workforce planning.
* Hands-on experience in Performance Management Systems, employee engagement, Learning & Development, and statutory compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook) and HRMS platforms.
* Strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English; regional language proficiency is an added advantage.
* A proactive, solution-oriented professional with strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, influence business decisions, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For

**A Talent Strategist. A People Champion. A Culture Builder. A Business Partner.**

Someone who doesn't just manage HR processes but
**creates measurable people impact and contributes to business growth.**

**Join Waggle and help shape the future of our people and organization!**
🚀

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to: hr@mywaggle.com
